data.one_liner: An Unsplash REST API client for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client to interact with the Unsplash REST API. Allows fetching metadata about photos, random photos, and handling custom photo variant URLs.
use_when: You need to fetch high-resolution photos and metadata from Unsplash in your application.
avoid_when: You need endpoints that act on behalf of a user, which are not implemented yet.
strengths: Easy setup with Unsplash app credentials.
Built-in utilities for resizing and customizing photo URLs.
weaknesses: Endpoints acting on behalf of a user are not yet implemented.
data.setup_notes: Requires registering as a developer on the Unsplash developer portal and obtaining credentials (access and secret keys).

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making custom raw HTTP requests to the Unsplash API rather than using a dedicated wrapper.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need advanced networking features like interceptors, global configuration, and robust error handling for REST requests.
